messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Maternity Leave]
Leave Entitlement

- Team members must have continuous employment with GitLab for at least 26 weeks leading up to the "qualifying week" (15th week before the expected week of childbirth)
- Up to 52 weeks leave available
- First 39 weeks paid (combining statutory and GitLab benefits)
- 90% of average earnings for first 6 weeks (before tax), then statutory rate (£194.32/week) or 90% (whichever is lower) of the team member's average weekly earnings (whichever is lower) for the next 33 weeks. This also applies to the leave amounts provided for Parental Leave and Adoption Leave.
- GitLab's enhanced policy provides up to 16 weeks at 100% salary

How to Apply

[2] [GitLab GK (Japan) Benefits > Health & Wellbeing Benefits > Family & Life Transition Support]
Maternity Leave & Benefits

**Overview**

Take 14 weeks of protected maternity leave with two-thirds of your base salary through government allowance.

**Eligibility**

- All pregnant GitLab GK team members
- Available regardless of employment length

**Key Features**

Leave starts 6 weeks before due date. Government provides 2/3 salary during entire leave period.

**How to Access**

1. **Plan**: Leave begins 6 weeks before delivery
2. **Apply**: Submit government allowance application
3. **Coordinate**: Work with manager and People Operations

**Important Information**

- May coordinate with [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/) if eligible

Parental Leave (Child Care Leave)

**Overview**

Take up to one year of protected leave with substantial government financial support.

**Eligibility**

- Available until child's first birthday
- Fixed-term employees need one year employment
- Must commit to return to work

**Key Features**

Receive 67% salary (first 6 months), 50% thereafter. Both parents can take leave.

**How to Access**

1. **Plan**: Starts after maternity leave (mothers) or from birth (fathers)
2. **Apply**: Submit allowance application
3. **Coordinate**: Arrange role coverage

**Important Information**

- May coordinate with [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/) if eligible

Additional Family Support

**Child Nursing Care Leave**: Up to 5 days (1 child) or 10 days (2+ children). Runs with GitLab PTO.

[3] [GitLab India Private Limited EOP Policy > 1.1 Policy Statement > 1.2 Scope > 1.4 Facilities and Amenities > 1.6 Other Facilities]
_Leave_ - GitLab may, based on a team member's request for leave which exceeds six consecutive days, for a reason related to their disability, administer the leave as a leave of absence through the GitLab Sick Time policy, under which eligible team members will receive 100% paid leave for up to 25 working days. GitLab’s Sick Time policy is administered concurrently with any statutory sick leave for which a team member may be eligible. This will be treated as a request for reasonable accommodation and will be evaluated accordingly. Team members should follow the [process in the Handbook for requesting this leave of absence](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#for-sick-absences-that-exceed-6-consecutive-days).

_Training and Career development_ - GitLab does not discriminate in providing training opportunities and any such opportunities would be available to all team members regardless of their protected characteristics. Every effort will be made to accommodate any special needs of team members by making reasonable adjustments to working arrangements. This applies to all aspects of employment, including training.

[4] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Maternity Leave]
GitLab provides comprehensive maternity leave support that goes beyond statutory requirements.  

Statutory Entitlement

- 26 weeks ordinary maternity leave  
- Additional 16 weeks unpaid leave available  
- Must start 2 weeks before due date  
- Minimum 4 weeks after birth

  

GitLab Support

- 100% salary for up to 16 weeks (includes state benefit top-up)  
- State Maternity Benefit: €262/week (subject to PRSI)  
- Support throughout your leave journey

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com with start/end dates
2. Receive completed MB2 form from Absence Management
3. Apply via [gov.ie](https://www.gov.ie/en/service/apply-for-maternity-benefit/) at least 6 weeks before leave
4. Submit time off in Workday (Parental Leave category)

[5] [Remote.com > **Clear benefits, real support** > **Italy 🇮🇹**]
If eligible, a team member's first 16 weeks of leave will be supplemented the remaining 20% per GitLab's [Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave). GitLab's Parental leave will run concurrently with any statutory leave and/or pay entitlements the team member is eligible for.

**Applying for Maternity Leave in Italy**

To initiate your parental leave, submit your time off by selecting the Parental Leave category in Workday at least 30 days before your leave starts. Please familiarize yourself with [GitLab's Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

**Paternity Leave**

Below is the information related to Italy's statutory leave policies. Please note that team members hired in Italy are hired via Remote (PEO) and you should always check with Remote first for the most up to date information.

Fathers are also obligated to take a seven-day paid leave of absence from work during the five months of maternity leave. The mother has the option to extend the father's paternal leave if she transfers one of her maternity days to him.

If eligible, team members can take up to 16 weeks of time away (in total) per GitLab's [Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave). GitLab's Parental leave will run concurrently with any statutory leave and/or pay entitlements the team member is eligible for.

[6] [GitLab Korea Limited Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Maternity Leave]
Comprehensive maternity leave for all team members giving birth.

Eligibility Requirements

- All team members giving birth
- Includes coverage for miscarriage or stillbirth with scaled leave periods

Leave Entitlement

- **Standard Leave**: 90 calendar days total
- **Multiple Births**: Extended to 120 calendar days
- **Flexible Timing**: Start date negotiable, but 45 days (60 for multiples) must follow delivery
- **Miscarriage/Stillbirth Support**: 5-90 days based on pregnancy duration
- **100% Pay Protection**: GitLab supplements insurance payments to ensure full salary continuation

How to Access

1. Submit leave request in Workday under "Parental Leave" category
2. Provide at least 30 days advance notice when possible
3. Coordinate start date with your manager
